newsitem.title: JAPAN: JNR auction a good sign for Japan economy -- MOF.
newsitem.headline: JNR auction a good sign for Japan economy -- MOF.

text.p: The result of an auction of land by the former Japan National Railways is a good sign for the Japanese economy, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a news conference on Tuesday.
Asked about the result of the auction, which produced a price higher than expectations, he said:
"It is a sign that points to an optimistic economic outlook."
He also said the auction price reflected the optimistic economic outlook of the bidders.

Three tracts of prime land in central Tokyo were auctioned by the JNR Settlement Corp on Monday for a total of 372.3 billion yen. The JNR Settlement Corp was set up in 1987 to sell off many of the assets of the now-defunct Japan National Railways when it was split up into seven regional companies.
